verdict.rationale: Airweave publishes an OpenAPI spec (airweave-probe-2) and code samples appear on its docs site (airweave-docs-25, airweave-comm-5), suggesting an API reference exists, but there's no direct evidence of an interactive, runnable-example console (e.g., a 'try it out' Swagger/Readme-style playground). Missing for 10: explicit documentation of an interactive API console, runnable example execution in-browser, independent confirmation of this UX.
